title: A heavier moving object
hook: Change mass and predict momentum magnitude.
misconception: momentum magnitude stays fixed when mass doubles.
objective: Apply p = mv to compare momentum magnitude when mass changes, under the stated assumptions.

claims.text: With a fixed speed along the same line, p = mv. When mass doubles, momentum magnitude becomes 2 times its original value.
claims.source: Idealized model p = mv; scaling exponent 1. Physics and assumptions await independent review.

recall.question: Consider a fixed speed along the same line, with a nonzero initial result. If mass triples from a positive value, what is the multiplier on momentum magnitude?
recall.why: Apply p = mv under the same assumptions: the multiplier is 3.
